exposure: proactive perinatal care with minimal handling
cohort: A total of 162 infants born between 220/7 and 256/7 weeks of gestation were included, with those born in Phase II (2020-2022) receiving proactive care and those in Phase I (2013-2019) serving as the comparison group.
finding: The implementation of proactive care with minimal handling significantly decreased mortality and improved composite outcomes of severe brain injury, sepsis, and necrotizing enterocolitis in periviable preterm infants.
